verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites give each agent its own persistent Linux box that checkpoints itself automatically while the agent works. A Sprite sleeps, wakes with its state intact, can roll back to any checkpoint, and keeps a growing persistent disk. This matches the story directly, though all of the evidence is homepage marketing copy. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of checkpoint mechanics and frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic checkpointing.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working

citations.quote: Every agent gets its own Linux box. A Sprite checkpoints itself while the agent works, so harnesses like Claude and Codex find everything where they left it.
Give it a Sprite that sleeps until it's needed and wakes up remembering everything.
Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds
Your disk grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite
